{{Quote|At the time the Ukatis system was interdicted by its own King. ''[&hellip;]'' I found myself a ship and a partner and we began smuggling food and supplies to the Ukatis citizenry through the blockade. ''[&hellip;]'' We only got caught once. A lone Ukatish frigate shot us down and forced a crash landing.|Jolee Bindo|<ref name="KOTOR">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
At some point by [[3996 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'' establishes that [[Jolee Bindo]]'s [[Starship/Legends|starship]] was shot down over [[Ukatis]] at some point before the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], which ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' dates to [[3996 BBY]].</ref> an '''individual''' partnered with the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Jolee Bindo]], who had acquired a [[Starship/Legends|starship]], in [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] and supplies through the blockade of the [[Ukatis system/Legends|Ukatis system]] ordered by its own [[Unidentified Ukatis system king|king]]. At one point, the [[Ukatis]] enforcer [[Nayama]], operating aboard a lone Ukatish [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]], shot Bindo's craft down and forced it to crash-land on the celestial body, after which the Jedi was [[Prisoner/Legends|imprisoned]] there.<ref name="KOTOR" />
